name: Austral
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

soil.rock: Volcanic rock is porous, so it drains well and sends roots deep. Lava soils are mostly basalt, rich in iron, calcium and magnesium. Schist, slate and gneiss break into stony, free-draining soil that holds the day's heat. Schist is rich in magnesium and potassium but poor in organic matter and nitrogen.

land: The high ground runs about 14°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.
